The most each channel can reach, on the Coyote\'s scale of 0 to 200. Each tap moves a limit by 5. You raise strength yourself on Live, and MagicHandy never goes past these limits or raises strength on its own.
Limits change only while the Coyote is disconnected. It gets them the next time it connects. A new Coyote starts at 0 on both channels.

One step per tap, up to the limits on the Coyote\'s page. A step waits until the Coyote reports the last one. Stop sets both channels to zero.
